pull.title: assumeutxo: replace `loadtxoutset` RPC with a startup arg
pull.body:
**Problem:** Loading a UTXO snapshot through RPC requires coordinating with the active chain, mempool, caches and advertised services while the node is running.

**Fix:** Replace the `loadtxoutset` RPC with `-loadtxoutset=<file>` and finish importing during chainstate initialization, before networking and mempool loading begin.
Require a receiver that has not advanced beyond genesis, already knows the snapshot base header and has no stored blocks beyond genesis or unfinished reindexing.
This removes runtime activation checks, temporary import cache resizing and service demotion while preserving snapshot validation, resumption and background validation.

index: ignore repeated genesis notifications

After reindexing an otherwise empty chainstate, an index can catch up to genesis before its queued BlockConnected notification arrives.
Ignore that notification when a best block is already indexed, so Rewind never receives a null parent.

Use the producer's tip time for every node's mocktime in the main and wallet tests.

committer Lőrinc <pap.lorinc@gmail.com> 1793916796 +0100

node: add startup loading for UTXO snapshots

Add -loadtxoutset=<file> and call the existing snapshot loader during chainstate initialization, before networking starts.
Both this option and the existing RPC use the same snapshot activation checks, including the requirement to know the base header.
The main import test retains the header index but removes the ordinary chainstate before importing.
Permit a missing active tip in the work comparisons while the RPC still needs those checks.
Publish the imported tip so startup can complete without an ordinary chainstate loaded from disk.
Treat interrupted imports as cancellation and report exceptions through the initialization error path.

Keep snapshot loading separate from reindexing and manual block-import modes.
Skip the GUI reindex retry when an import is requested, since these startup modes cannot be combined.

validation: remove redundant snapshot checks

Now that imports happen only at startup, the active chain cannot advance during an import and the mempool has not been loaded yet.
Startup also rejects a new import if a snapshot chainstate already exists.

Remove these checks from snapshot activation.
A supported snapshot has more work than the genesis chainstate, which cannot advance during import, so both work comparisons are redundant.
Remove the test helper's temporary tip rewind as well.
Also remove the unit and fuzz checks that attempt another import.

Only the old RPC needed the details of the snapshot's base block in the result.
Return no value on success and keep the error message on failure.
Keep the checks on the base header, the supported snapshot commitment and the snapshot contents.

fuzz: stop removing local service flags

The node now announces its limited ability to serve blocks before it accepts any peers.
Loading a snapshot therefore no longer needs to remove service flags from a running node.

Delete `RemoveLocalServices`, and update the fuzz test to keep track of flags as they are added.
The node can still announce full block service once background validation completes.
